inputs.share_count_basis: Issued 325,080,956 less treasury 14,718,274 at 2025-12-31 (Q3 FY2026 tanshin). Share acquisition rights of JPY40m (8th-10th series options, a few thousand shares) are immaterial. Held FLAT: SBC is expensed (at ~0) and the FY2026 buyback is value-neutral in this model. The programme bought a further ~2.6m shares (~JPY6.2bn) in Jan-Mar 2026 after the balance-sheet date; applying both the lower count and the higher net debt moves value per share by well under 1%, so the filing's own anchors are kept.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 yuho (Stock Options, etc.): 'Recognized expenses: Not applicable'. Only equity award in the year was a restricted-stock allocation of 37,211 shares (~JPY93m at grant). SBC-zero market; house and street bases coincide.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 financing outflow JPY13m (none). FY2026: up-to-JPY25bn programme announced 2025-11-04, JPY18,771m spent to 2025-12-31 (8.15m shares), completed March 2026 at 10,717,500 shares / JPY24,999.8m per the Analysis JSON.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-30T06:30:00Z (TSE regular close, Friday 30 Oct 2026; not an after-hours print)
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in JPY, the currency of the flows. Rf 1.7% (10y JGB, Oct 2026), ERP 6.0%, beta 1.0 for a large-cap diversified chemical -> cost of equity 7.7%; after-tax cost of debt ~1.0% on JPY208bn of borrowings (interest paid JPY2.8bn FY2025, 1.3% pre-tax); market weights ~92/8 give 7.2%, rounded to 7.5%. No cyclicality premium is stacked on top: the chemical cycle, China overcapacity and the Tosoh SMD risk are priced in the scenario flows and weights (risk charged once). The house ~9% keiretsu reference is for small-cap single-customer auto suppliers and is not applied to a JPY790bn five-segment group.
inputs.lease_treatment: J-GAAP filer: operating leases are already expensed inside operating income, so no lease adjustment is made to the flows. Finance-lease liabilities are JPY0.5-0.8bn (FY2025 yuho note) and are excluded from net debt as immaterial. Organo's 'investments in leases' (JPY35.5bn) are customer equipment-ownership receivables, an operating asset, left in working capital.
inputs.nci_treatment: Charged ONCE, in the flows. The non-controlling interest (JPY80.3bn book at 2025-12-31) is mostly the ~50% of Organo Corporation (6368.T, water-treatment engineering) that Tosoh does not own, and NCI took 14% (FY2024) / 19% (FY2025) of consolidated net income, rising as Engineering outgrows the chemical segments. Because the consolidated flows carry 100% of Organo, the NCI profit share is folded into the cash-leakage driver: cash_tax_rate_path = 1 - (1 - 0.31 tax) x (1 - 0.17 NCI) = 43% (bear 45%: Engineering is a larger share of a smaller profit pool). Calibration: FY2025 EBIT 98,906 x (1 - 0.43) = 56.4bn vs reported attributable net income 58.0bn -- ties within non-operating noise. NO separate NCI deduction is made in the equity bridge; adding the JPY80bn book value would charge the minority twice.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md row 'operating company, non-US or cyclical: industrials'), with the adaptations file applied: JPY-built WACC, J-GAAP lease treatment, NCI via leakage, matching-asset rule for investment securities, SBC-zero band collapse, risk charged once. First valuation of this ticker (no memory entry). FLOWS: EBITDA = operating income + D&A, so interest income (JPY1.4bn), dividend income (JPY1.5bn) and equity-method profit (JPY3.3bn) are outside the flows by construction; their source assets (investment securities JPY78.0bn: ~JPY57bn available-for-sale cross-shareholdings at fair value plus ~JPY21bn equity-method affiliates at book) are added once in equity_bridge, and cash is netted once in net_debt. The retirement-benefit asset (JPY46bn) is not added. VINTAGE WARNING: the latest filing in the folder is the Q3 FY2026 tanshin (period to 2025-12-31, released 2026-02-05). FY2026 full-year results (due May 2026) and Q1 FY2027 (due Aug 2026) exist but are not extracted, so FY0 is FY2025 actual and Y1 (FY2026) is the February 2026 guidance (sales JPY1,010bn, OI JPY90bn, after two cuts). Balance-sheet anchors are ten months old; refresh net debt, share count and the FY2027 guidance when those filings are extracted. The Tosoh SMD impairment (JPY19.1bn, H1 FY2026) is non-cash and does not enter the flows; its economic effect is carried as the Specialty margin not recovering in the bear case. Working capital: receivables + inventories - payables = JPY425bn, 40% of revenue, so growth consumes cash; wc_capture -30% (naphtha-driven inventory value moves partly offset volume growth). Y1's 5% revenue decline therefore releases cash, which matches the 9M FY2026 cash-flow statement.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case revenue path FY2027-FY2031 average (2.3%) rounded; equity CAGR rejected as a forward proxy
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 7.8% vs EPS 5yr CAGR 1.3% (>30% divergence). Book value compounds because payout was ~45% of a cyclically high FY2022 peak, not because the earnings base is growing; revenue 5yr CAGR 6.2% was inflated by the FY2022-23 naphtha/price spike (FY2023 revenue JPY1,064bn on an FY2023 EBITDA margin of 11%). Owner-FCF CAGRs are negative on both windows because FY2022 and FY2020 are peak-to-trough endpoints and capex rose from JPY44bn to JPY80bn.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs are on owner FCF (reported FCF less ~JPY0.1bn SBC); FY2019 and FY2014 have no FCF in the CSV (capex missing) so the windows use FY2020->FY2025 and FY2022->FY2025. SBC is immaterial so owner and reported series are the same to within 0.4%.

base.growth_note: Y1 = FY2026 guidance (JPY1,010bn, -5.0%). FY2027-28 recover 2.5-3% as Nanyo maintenance volumes return and Engineering backlog converts; fade to 1.5% (Japan nominal GDP, chemicals ex-growth, mix shifting to Engineering/Specialty).
base.margin_note: Y1 13.7% = guided OI JPY90bn + D&A ~JPY48bn on JPY1,010bn. Mid-cycle 15.5% (OI ~10.5%, ~JPY115-120bn by FY2029) is the FY2016-25 average of 15.8% less a point for structural China chlor-alkali/PVC overcapacity. The medium-term plan's JPY170bn OI (FY2028) is NOT assumed in base.
base.capex_note: FY2026 run-rate 7.5% (9M JPY57bn; SMD/Grove City and chlorine-derivative projects, CIP JPY86bn) fading to 5.5% (FY2016-25 average); D&A rises to 5.0% as that capex depreciates, leaving 0.5% of revenue net investment for 1.5% growth at ~40% capital intensity.
base.tax_note: 43% = combined 31% Japanese cash tax (FY2025 cash tax JPY32bn on pre-tax JPY101bn) and 17% NCI profit share; see inputs.nci_treatment.

bull.margin_note: 18% EBITDA (OI ~13%, ~JPY150bn by FY2029) is the medium-term plan reached one year late and ~85% delivered; the FY2017-18 and FY2022 peaks were 19-20%.

bear.margin_note: 12-12.5% EBITDA is FY2023-24 (OI JPY80bn on a bigger revenue base): chlor-alkali and petrochemical earn roughly zero through the cycle, Specialty does not recover the SMD volumes, Engineering alone holds the group. NCI leakage 45% because Organo is then a larger share of a smaller profit pool.

scenario_narratives.base: FY2026 lands on the twice-cut February guidance (sales JPY1,010bn, OI JPY90bn) with Nanyo maintenance and a lower naphtha price behind it. From FY2027 the chemical chain recovers to a mid-cycle rather than a peak: chlor-alkali and petrochemical earn thin but positive margins under persistent Chinese caustic/PVC/PE overcapacity, Specialty holds ~14% OI with Tosoh SMD flat, and Engineering keeps converting its semiconductor-fab water-treatment backlog at double-digit growth. Group EBITDA margin settles at 15.5% (OI ~JPY115-120bn), two-thirds of the way to the JPY170bn medium-term target, with capex normalising from JPY80bn to ~JPY60bn as the current project wave completes. Half of Organo's cash stays with its minority shareholders.
scenario_narratives.bull: The FY2026-28 plan is largely delivered a year late: naphtha stays low and the yen stays weak, chlorine-derivative and MDI pricing recovers as Chinese capacity additions slow, the US semiconductor capex cycle turns and refills Tosoh SMD's sputtering-target volumes (reversing the impairment's volume loss, not the charge), and Organo's Taiwan/US/Japan fab pipeline keeps growing at mid-teens. EBITDA margin reaches 18% (OI ~JPY150bn) by FY2029 and revenue compounds ~3% a year; the 50% payout plus further buybacks are funded from cash flow rather than borrowings.
scenario_narratives.bear: Chinese overcapacity in caustic soda, PVC and polyethylene proves structural through 2030, US tariffs keep chloroprene and export volumes weak, and the two FY2026 guidance cuts turn out to be the first of several: petrochemical and chlor-alkali run at roughly zero operating income through the cycle, Specialty stays at FY2026 levels with a further SMD write-down possible, and only Engineering grows. Revenue falls again in FY2027 and then grows 1%; EBITDA margin sits at 12-12.5% (OI ~JPY75-80bn), capex cannot be cut below 5.5% of sales because of decarbonisation spend, and the JPY100 dividend is maintained by borrowing. Minority leakage rises because Organo is a bigger share of a smaller profit pool.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Moved from the house 15/50/35 to 25/50/25. Bear weight up: guidance has been cut twice in four months, 52% of revenue is commodity chlor-alkali/petrochemical whose pricing is set by Chinese capacity, and the bear case is not a solvency case (net debt 0.5x EBITDA) but a prolonged margin trough that the balance sheet can absorb -- so it is likelier than a tail. Bull weight down: the bull needs three independent things (naphtha/yen, Chinese capacity discipline, US semiconductor capex recovery) to go right at once, and the medium-term plan's JPY170bn OI is 90% above FY2026 guidance.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Tosoh is valued as a mid-cycle cash-flow stream, not at its FY2022 peak or its FY2026 trough. The consolidated flows carry 100% of Organo, so the minority is charged inside the flows (43-45% combined tax and leakage) rather than at book in the bridge; investment securities are added once because their income is outside the EBITDA-based flows. The terminal value is capped at 15x owner FCF (the upper end of the house cyclical range; Gordon at 7.5%/1.5% would be 16.9x) -- a cap that works out to roughly 5x terminal EBITDA, below the stock's own ~6x today, so no re-rating is assumed. SBC is nil, so house and street coincide and band_position is null.
key_risks_to_valuation: Balance-sheet and guidance anchors are from the 2025-12-31 Q3 tanshin; FY2026 actuals and FY2027 guidance (May/Aug 2026) are not in the folder and could move Y1-Y2 materially
Chinese chlor-alkali/PVC/PE capacity additions keeping chemical-chain margins near zero for longer than the bear case assumes
Tosoh SMD: a second impairment or a slower US semiconductor recovery than the base assumes (Specialty held flat, not recovering)
NCI leakage modelled at 17-19% of profit; if Engineering grows faster than the chemical chain, the leakage rises and group value per share falls even as consolidated profit grows
Capex intensity: the plan's decarbonisation (30% CO2 cut by 2028) and chlorine-derivative projects could hold capex at 7-8% of sales rather than fading to 5.5%
Naphtha and USD/JPY: a 10-yen stronger yen or a naphtha spike is worth several points of chemical-chain margin in either direction
